Name: Rita's Utopia Farm
Author: RitaEmiko
Description:
This map is very spacious and beautiful (in my opinion lol)
Creeks and falls gives extra peacefulness. 
*Grandpa is located in a pretty place for sure.

大！好看！（至少我认为）
山涧与瀑布是很让人放松的。
*爷爷在僻静的地方安眠

The map has multiple areas separated for different purposes. Try to use and decorate as you please.
There are also few warp stones for easy access. (If you are tired of the view)

不同区域以不同功能划分，你可以自行设计装饰。
地图上有多个传送石已方便你的出行（如果你不想看风景了的话）

This is my first time trying map creation and coding. I'm happy to hear if you have any questions or issues to report to. I'll get to it once I'm free.
这是我第一次尝试制作和写代码，如果有何反馈，我很乐意倾听并且在我有空的时候试着修改。

Currently known issue:
The tiles in front of the greenhouse is weird but I won't have time to fix it for now (mostly likely not affecting the gameplay). I'll be back soon to work on it.
已知问题：温室前的地砖部分看起来有问题，但应该不影响游玩。

PS: Cave Location - There's a small road right on the left of the center bottom bridge. It's covered by the tree and leaves.
PS：农场洞穴在正下方过桥后出口前的左侧。在树后的小路过河后的瀑布后面。

Mod Required:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[/url]This is needed because I can't find a good ladder from vanilla game﻿. Other than this everything should be vanilla.

Downloads.Description:
Fixed furniture catalog unable to open bug issue;
Removed stump from south of map which stop player from entering the farm cave early.
